seen.body: Owner words, relayed verbatim by Santa: 'there are probably gated items too which require a gated tag because they require external keys etc'. Gated = blocked on keys, credentials, hardware or a live account, NOT waiting for human approval (that stays needs:approval). Label gated: own Gated board column (after Needs approval), never offered by qew ready, the reason kept on the item (qew set ITEM --add-label gated --reason TEXT records a comment 'gated: TEXT'). Epics are unaffected like for needs:approval.
seen.title: A gated label: work blocked on something outside the repository gets its own Gated column and is never ready
